ideas.pitch: A Poisson GAM-based predictive forecasting engine to estimate the frequency and severity of enterprise AI security incidents and model failures over rolling backtest windows.
ideas.title: IncidentCast-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact technical architecture of winning forecasting systems by using statistical calibration and Poisson regression rather than generic LLM wrappers, appealing to rigorous engineering judges.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-integrated graph intelligence and gradient-boosting platform designed to detect complex anti-money laundering transaction rings and explain high-risk entity behaviors.
ideas.title: GraphAML-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines graph data structures with explainable gradient boosting, providing the hard technical depth that judges reward in financial and security AI hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A natural language no-code trading bot builder that parses user intent, constructs execution strategies, and backtests them against perpetual market APIs.
ideas.title: TradeNoCode-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates practical financial utility and complex state execution within a tight window, following the winning pattern of autonomous execution platforms.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite imagery monitoring system that processes spatial raster files to detect illegal industrial land usage and environmental compliance breaches.
ideas.title: GeoAudit-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings heavy domain-specific utility to industrial monitoring, replicating the exact niche infrastructure success seen in satellite-based compliance runner-ups.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise video intelligence platform that converts hours of unstructured meeting and screencast recordings into a fully searchable, semantically queryable database.
ideas.title: VideoLibrAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate productivity bottleneck with polished vector search and UI integration, directly emulating multi-prize-winning data intelligence applications.
